newsitem.title: USA: US PLAINS CATTLE SALES MODERATE AT $65 - FEEDLOTS.
newsitem.headline: US PLAINS CATTLE SALES MODERATE AT $65 - FEEDLOTS.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle trade near midday on Wednesday was light to moderate at $65.00 per cwt, steady with Tuesday's late sales, feedlot sources said.
About 15,000 head had sold in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area, which brought the week-to-date figure near 60,900 head, Texas and Oklahoma cattle feeders said.
Kansas sales near midday were pegged near 5,000, which brought the weekly figure near 56,600, sources there said.
Fed cattle sales at $65.00 were off $1.00 from last week's top, but still provided small profits to some cattle feeder, which accounted for activity at that level, sources said.
